name: claude-kit
description: Evidence-gated SDLC for Claude Code, installed as configuration (no app code, no Docker). `claude-kit init` asks ordered questions and installs CLAUDE.md + .claude/ (rules, the profile's agents/skills, hooks, artifact templates) + optional .mcp.json; run /sdlc to drive spec → review → build → test → security → ship through profile-aware quality gates with a tamper-evident gate ledger, working memory, and a self-improving learnings loop.
